title: Commercial Property Legal Secretary/Assistant - York
description:
Commercial Property Legal Secretary
Location: York, North Yorkshire
Salary: £26,000 - £33,000, depending on experience
Hours: 9:00am - 5:00pm, Monday to Friday
Contract: Permanent, Full-time
Working Pattern: Office Based

Are you an experienced Property Legal Secretary or Legal Assistant looking for a new opportunity in York?

We are recruiting for a Commercial Property Legal Secretary to join the property team of a well-established law firm.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone with a strong legal secretarial or administrative background who already has experience supporting fee earners within Property Law.

While direct Commercial Property experience would be advantageous, candidates who have supported fee earners within Residential Conveyancing, Real Estate or another property-focused legal department are also encouraged to apply.

The Role

Working closely with solicitors and other fee earners, you will provide comprehensive secretarial and administrative support across a varied Commercial Property caseload.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Providing high-quality secretarial and administrative support to Property Law fee earners
- Preparing, formatting and amending legal correspondence, reports and property documentation
- Opening, maintaining and closing client and matter files
- Liaising professionally with clients, solicitors, agents, lenders and other third parties
- Managing diaries, appointments, meetings and key dates
- Handling telephone calls, emails and correspondence efficiently
- Updating the firm's case management system and maintaining accurate records
- Assisting with Land Registry documentation, searches and property-related administration
- Preparing documents and correspondence relating to commercial property transactions
- Supporting fee earners with the day-to-day progression of matters
- Maintaining confidentiality and ensuring a consistently high standard of accuracy
- Providing wider administrative support to the Commercial Property team when required

About You

Previous experience supporting fee earners within Property Law is essential for this position.

You may currently be working as a Commercial Property Legal Secretary, Real Estate Legal Secretary, Property Legal Assistant, Conveyancing Legal Secretary or experienced Property Legal Administrator.

Direct Commercial Property experience would be particularly welcomed, although applications are also encouraged from candidates with a strong Residential Property background who are interested in moving into Commercial Property.

You will also need:
- Strong legal secretarial and administrative skills
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy
- The ability to manage a busy workload and competing priorities
- Confidence communicating with clients and professional third parties
- Strong Microsoft Office and case management system skills
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- A professional, organised and proactive approach
- The ability to work effectively as part of a busy property team

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Property Legal Secretary to join a busy Commercial Property team and further develop their career within Commercial Real Estate and Property Law.

Interested? Apply today or get in touch for a confidential discussion.

title: Commercial Property Paralegal Commercial Property Transactions Malton / York
description:
Commercial Property Paralegal Commercial Property Transactions Malton / York
Location: Malton or York
Salary: £26,000 - £32,000 DOE
Full Time

If you're a Commercial Property Paralegal with at least a year's experience in the practice area, this is an opportunity to join an established team where you can continue to build your experience across a broad range of commercial property work.

This isn't a role for someone looking to simply assist from the sidelines. You'll be involved in the day-to-day running of commercial property matters, working with experienced lawyers and developing your ability to manage transactions, deal with clients and take increasing responsibility for your own workload.

The work covers a broad commercial property caseload, giving you exposure to different types of transactions and clients rather than tying you to one particular niche.
You'll be involved in:
- Commercial property sales and purchases
- Landlord and tenant matters
- Commercial leases
- Property-related development work
- General commercial property transactions
- Supporting solicitors on more complex matters
- Liaising with clients, agents and other parties throughout transactions
- Managing files and keeping matters progressing efficiently

The ideal candidate will have at least 1 year's commercial property experience, with 2-3 years of overall paralegal experience preferred.

You don't need to be qualified and you don't need to have every aspect of commercial property covered. What matters is that you've gained genuine practical experience in the area, understand how transactions progress and are ready to take the next step in your development.

You'll also need to be comfortable dealing directly with clients and working as part of a friendly, approachable team. A driving licence and access to a car would be advantageous, particularly given the firm's office locations and client base.

This is a good opportunity for a Commercial Property Paralegal, Property Paralegal or experienced Legal Assistant who wants to develop their technical knowledge, take on more responsibility and work alongside experienced commercial property lawyers.

There's a strong emphasis on professional development, with structured and supported training alongside a wider benefits package including a bonus scheme, enhanced annual leave, health and wellbeing benefits, long-service recognition and cycle-to-work scheme.

If you're a Commercial Property Paralegal with 1-3 years' experience and are looking for your next move around Malton, York or the wider North Yorkshire market, I'd be keen to have a confidential conversation.

For a confidential discussion and to learn more about the firm behind the opportunity, please contact Eoghan at QED Legal Recruitment Ltd.

title: Paralegal
description:
Administration of Affairs Paralegal
- Location: York City Centre
- Job Type: Full-time
- Annual salary: Competitive in line with market rate
- Working Hours: Monday to Friday 9-5.30pm

We are seeking a capable, organised, and compassionate Administration of Affairs Paralegal to join our Client's Private Client Team. This role is ideal for someone with a keen attention to detail, excellent communication skills, and a genuine interest in supporting vulnerable clients and their families.

Day-to-day of the role:
- Assist the Directors with the day-to-day administration and management of clients' financial affairs.
- Process payments for care fees, household bills, utilities, and other liabilities.
- Monitor client bank accounts, reconcile transactions, and maintain accurate financial records and schedules.
- Liaise with clients, family members, care providers, financial institutions, estate agents, and other third parties.
- Support the preparation of documentation connected with tax returns, care funding assessments, benefit applications, and related financial administration.
- Assist with the sale and purchase of properties, including liaising with estate agents and other professionals on behalf of the Directors.
- Attend client meetings where appropriate, preparing attendance notes or follow-up correspondence.
- Assist with onboarding new administration of affairs clients.
- Maintain accurate client files, diarise key dates, and ensure compliance with internal procedures.
- Respond to queries from clients, family members, care providers, and professional contacts in a sensitive and professional manner.
- Ensure all file management, record keeping, and client communications are maintained to a high professional standard.

Required Skills & Qualifications:
- Previous experience as a paralegal, legal assistant, legal secretary, or administrator, ideally within Private Client or a related area.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- A sensitive, professional, and confidential approach when dealing with clients and families.
- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
- Confidence handling financial information and maintaining accurate records.
- Ability to manage competing priorities and work effectively as part of a team.
- Proactive, practical, and client-focused approach.
- Confidence using technology and a willingness to work with new systems and AI tools where appropriate.
- High standards of client care, with empathy and understanding for clients who may be experiencing difficult circumstances.

Benefits:
- Competitive salary
- Realistic targets
- Wellbeing support
- Vibrant social scene
- Comprehensive benefits package including pension, life cover, enhanced maternity and paternity pay, health cash plan, staff discounts, competitive holidays (plus a day off for your birthday!), and a cycle to work scheme

title: Residential Property Legal Secretary / Assistant - York

Hours: 9:00am - 5:00pm, Monday to Friday
Contract: Permanent, Full-time

To be considered, you will need previous experience within a legal administration, legal secretarial or legal assistant position.

Experience within Residential Conveyancing or Property Law would be an advantage, but is desirable rather than essential. Training on the specific requirements of the department can be provided to someone with a strong legal administration background.

You should also be:
- Highly organised with excellent attention to detail

- Comfortable communicating with clients and third parties
- Professional, approachable and client focused
- Confident using Microsoft Office and case management systems
- A strong written and verbal communicator

This is a great opportunity for an experienced Legal Secretary, Legal Assistant or Legal Administrator looking to join a Residential Property team and potentially develop their experience within conveyancing and property law.

Interested? Apply today or get in touch for a confidential discussion.
